page.overview:
What is Flaming Pie?

Flaming Pie is the tenth studio album by Paul McCartney, released on May 5 1997. The album was co-produced by McCartney, Jeff Lynne and George Martin, and features and Ringo Starr as guest musicians.

All tracks written by Paul McCartney, except "Used to Be Bad" by McCartney & Steve Miller; and "Really Love You" by McCartney and Richard Starkey
